posts.title: Peanuts Thanksgiving Gingerbread
posts.description: Happy Thanksgiving! I'm so happy to be sharing a brand new Peanuts gingerbread scene with you for the holiday: Thanksgiving dinner where Snoopy makes a feast of buttered toast, popcorn, and milkshakes for everyone to eat. posts.title: Mooncake Cookie (Salted Egg Yolk, Rice Cereal, and White Chocolate)
posts.description: Instead of sharing a new mooncake recipe this year, I wanted to share my take of a classic mooncake in cookie form, the flavours of something familiar, in a new way. Each cookie features salted egg yolk, caramelized rice cereal, white chocolate, and a traditonal mooncake crisp. The post Mooncake Cookie (Salted Egg Yolk, Rice Cereal, and White Chocolate) appeared first on Constellation Inspiration

posts.title: Egg Tart Ice Cream
posts.description: An ice cream version of a traditional Chinese egg tart! Buttery homemade tart shells are filled with a rich egg custard ice cream and frozen before serving. They taste exactly like a fresh egg tart from a Chinese bakery or cha chaan teng, arguably the best pastry of all time. The post Egg Tart Ice Cream appeared first on Constellation Inspiration .
